# compute glibc rand first values and MLCG
import ctypes
libc=ctypes.CDLL('libc.so.6')
libc.srand(1)
bs=[libc.rand() & 0xff for _ in range(4)]
seed=bs[0]|bs[1]<<8|bs[2]<<16|bs[3]<<24
print(bs, hex(seed))
s=seed
out=[]
for _ in range(8):
    tmp=33614*s
    q=(tmp & 0xffffffff)>>1
    p=tmp>>32
    mlcg=p+q
    if mlcg & 0x80000000:
        mlcg &=0x7fffffff; mlcg+=1
    s=mlcg
    out.append(s & 0xff)
print('raw', [hex(x) for x in out])
out[0] &= ~1; out[0] |= 2
print('ext', bytes(out).hex())
iid=out.copy(); iid[0]^=2
print('iid', bytes(iid).hex())
print('linklocal', 'fe80'+'0000'*3+bytes(iid).hex())
PY
